pr_title: Adds Indexes and Index Options asset types (Backtesting/Live, IB only)
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
## This is a draft PR. It'll be complete tomorrow once I finish adding some tests

Adds Index asset type (work of @itsbalamurali - thank you 🙂)

  * Indexes will be available for: SPX, NDX, VIX

Adds Index options asset type 

 * Index options will be available for: SPX, NDX, VIX

Adds live trading support on IB for index options

Currently, IndexOption regression algos are and will be failing until they're updated. New data will be added for the regression algo test cases so that they can run locally.

issue_context.title: Index Options Support
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior

Index options available e.g. SPX

#### Actual Behavior
Only equity options available. e.g. SPY

#### Potential Solution
Implement index options.
